recap.text: Taranis, a god of thunder, protects a pig named Penelope on Team One Fine Pig. Carl threatens to kill the pig to force Taranis to arrive at a boss battle. Taranis kills Emberus after Penelope takes a hit for Carl. Taranis takes Samantha, Krakaren Prime, and Prepotente's memorial crystal before leaving.

beats.headline: The pig has a god
beats.text: Team One Fine Pig: two tigrans, Nico and Dario, in a throuple with a pig named Penelope. The interesting line in that file is not the throuple. It is that Penelope is under the protection of Taranis. A god of thunder has taken a personal interest in a pig on a racing team, and every crawler who reads that entry is going to file it somewhere and keep it.
beats.gist: Taranis, a god of thunder, protects Penelope, a pig on the Team One Fine Pig racing team.

beats.headline: Somebody found the lever
beats.text: The boss battle is on and Crawler Carl is spending his messages carefully. One goes to Emberus: I know who killed your son, meet me in the Scolopendra Club. The other is not a message so much as a hostage note. Taranis is in love with the pig. Carl says he will kill the pig if Taranis does not come and stop him. The god of thunder is now a scheduled arrival, and he was invited by threat.
beats.gist: Carl invites Taranis, the god of thunder, to stop him by threatening to kill the pig.

beats.headline: He kills Emberus over the pig
beats.text: Emberus, pinned and made briefly vulnerable by two bolts from Princess Donut, swings at Crawler Carl. Penelope takes the hit instead, because of a Four-Leaf Clover Patch and the sort of luck this floor generates. Taranis kills him for it. A fire god, patron and quest-giver, removed from the arena inside a second by a thunder god defending a pig. I want everyone at home to appreciate the proportions here.
beats.gist: Taranis kills Emberus for hitting Penelope instead of Carl.

beats.headline: Two pieces of his mother
beats.text: Eris empties the arena's pockets and leaves. Khepri leaves. Taranis says he is taking two pieces of his mother with him, and goes, and what he takes with him is Samantha and Krakaren Prime. He does not explain the sentence. Nobody in the arena asks him to. I have the transcript and I have run it four times, and I am telling you exactly what he said and nothing more.
beats.gist: Taranis takes Samantha and Krakaren Prime, calling them two pieces of his mother, and leaves.

beats.headline: He takes the crystal on his way out
beats.text: Inventory note from the close of the boss battle. Prepotente's memorial crystal is gone, and Taranis took it. Crawler Carl finds a different one in the wreckage, made by a god dying in that arena, which is not the crystal anybody wanted and is the one that is left. The stairwells to the twelfth floor are open.
beats.gist: Taranis takes Prepotente's memorial crystal, leaving Carl a different crystal from a dying god.

relations.note: One of the two pieces he takes with him
